_meta.dataset: Official hours + published menu pricing evidence per MICHELIN restaurant
rules: Only values printed on the venue's own website are filled in.
Anything not published officially is left null and classed 'unverified'.
Per-person cost ranges are labelled: exact = printed on official site; unverified = not published.
